title: Media Downloader (yt-dlp)
description: Downloads a video as a browser-friendly MP4 (H.264/AAC) or just its audio (MP3, M4A, Opus, WAV or FLAC) from YouTube and the other sites yt-dlp supports, with optional trimming and playlists. Runs on a CPU runtime. Only download content you have the right to download.
author: NZAP Labs

params.label: Link
params.description: A video page, playlist or direct media URL.

params.label: Video quality
params.description: The highest resolution to fetch; H.264 sources are preferred so nothing needs re-encoding. Ignored for audio.

params.label: Audio bitrate (kbps)
params.description: For MP3, M4A and Opus; WAV and FLAC are lossless.

params.label: Start at
params.description: Optional trim start, such as 1:30 or 90. Leave empty for the beginning.

params.label: End at
params.description: Optional trim end, such as 2:45. Leave empty for the end.

params.label: Download the playlist
params.description: When the link is a playlist (or a video inside one), download several items as a zip.

params.label: Playlist items (max)
params.description: How many playlist items to download, 1 to 50.
